sensors.name: right light sensor RLIGHT (light from above)
left light sensor LLIGHT (light from above)
line tracker, light % of the floor

control_flow: followInTheDark: if the right light is below 60 %, steer by the left light and the line tracker, else call avoidWalls.
avoidWalls: in dim light turn away from a wall on the left or right, else call driveInTheDark; in bright light call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: in dim light drive forward at 30 %, in bright light call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if something is in front, stop, else call followLine.
followLine: curve left on black, curve right otherwise.

likely_intent.description: In the dark, follow the black line under the robot and drive straight where there is none; in the light, follow the line as before.

decision_points.condition: the right light sensor reads less than 60 % (the robot is inside a tunnel)

branches.outcome: the light is below 60 %: it chooses how to steer by the left light and the line tracker
the light is 60 % or more: it calls avoidWalls

decision_points.condition: first the left light is below 45 %, second the line tracker reads more than 95 %

branches.outcome: left light below 45 %: curve left at 15 % and 35 %
left light 45 % or more and the line tracker over 95 %: curve right at 35 % and 15 %

decision_points.condition: the left light sensor reads less than 70 %

branches.outcome: below 70 %: it checks the obstacle sensors
70 % or more, bright light: it calls driveInTheDark

decision_points.condition: first a wall on the left, second a wall on the right

branches.outcome: a wall on the left: turn right 20°
no wall on the left, a wall on the right: turn left 20°
no wall on either side: call driveInTheDark

decision_points.condition: the left light sensor reads less than 70 %

branches.outcome: 70 % or more, bright light: call stopAtWall

decision_points.condition: something is in front of the robot (obstacle sensor FRONT)

branches.outcome: no black: curve right at 40 % and 10 %
